gen_risks.description: Lack of existing IT systems in seven key agencies hampers automation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide phased ICT capacity‑building, hire external experts, and deploy interim manual‑to‑digital processes.
gen_risks.evidence: Seven institutions have no IT system in place.

gen_risks.description: Incomplete digitization of legacy registers (45‑50% only) limits data quality.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prioritize digitization of high‑volume registers and allocate dedicated budget for scanning and validation.
gen_risks.evidence: Only 45‑50% of the archive is digitized.

gen_risks.description: ADISA’s weak procurement capacity (new agency) creates high procurement risk.
gen_risks.mitigation: Accelerate recruitment of procurement specialists, provide Bank‑led training, and use experienced consultants for early contracts.
gen_risks.evidence: Procurement risk rating is High; very weak procurement capacity at ADISA.

gen_risks.description: Overall financial management risk is rated as Substantial.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement a detailed Financial Management Manual, hire two finance specialists, and conduct regular internal audits.
gen_risks.evidence: The overall financial management risk is rated as Substantial.

gen_risks.description: Unfinalized design and financing model for the CSC may delay construction.
gen_risks.mitigation: Finalize architectural design and financing (PPP or public) within the first project year; set firm construction milestones.
gen_risks.evidence: The core features and size of this new building have not been decided; financing models are being considered.

gen_risks.description: Compressed implementation timeline may cause missed milestones.
gen_risks.mitigation: Use results‑based incentives, monitor quarterly milestones, and allow schedule adjustments where necessary.
gen_risks.evidence: The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk.

gen_risks.description: Delay in passing omnibus legislation could stall regulatory reforms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a legislative task‑force, engage parliament early, and align reform drafts with existing legal frameworks.
gen_risks.evidence: Omnibus legislation expected to be passed by the end of 2016.

gen_risks.description: Front‑office staff may resist process re‑engineering.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy a change‑management program with training, incentives, and clear communication of benefits.
gen_risks.evidence: Field level staff is likely to resist the reform.

gen_risks.description: Low internet penetration limits uptake of e‑services.
gen_risks.mitigation: Set up assisted‑access points (internet cafés, community centres) and maintain non‑digital service channels.
gen_risks.evidence: Only 60 internet users per 100 people in 2013.

gen_risks.description: Emphasis on digital services could exclude poor and vulnerable groups.
gen_risks.mitigation: Preserve physical service points, provide assisted digital access, and run targeted outreach campaigns.
gen_risks.evidence: Risk that focus on state‑of‑the‑art means will diminish access of the poor and vulnerable.

gen_risks.description: Construction of the CSC may cause dust, noise, waste and traffic impacts.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement the Environmental Management Plan with monitoring, dust suppression, waste management, and traffic control.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential environmental impacts include dust and noise, waste generation, traffic and safety issues.

gen_risks.description: High public perception of corruption may undermine trust in new services.
gen_risks.mitigation: Strengthen citizen‑feedback mechanism, publish performance data, and conduct anti‑corruption training for staff.
gen_risks.evidence: Citizens still view corruption as a significant problem; bribery prevalence 19.3%.

gen_risks.description: Project depends on NAIS’s capacity to integrate databases and e‑government platforms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Formalize service‑level agreements with NAIS, provide joint capacity‑building workshops, and monitor integration milestones.
gen_risks.evidence: NAIS is the coordinating and regulatory authority responsible for the Government Interoperability Platform.

gen_risks.description: Government’s limited experience with results‑based financing may affect DLI achievement.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide dedicated RBF training, embed Bank technical assistance, and set up a DLI tracking unit within the PMU.
gen_risks.evidence: GoA has limited experience with results‑based lending.

gen_risks.description: PMU staffing gaps (unfilled procurement and admin positions) risk implementation delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Fast‑track recruitment, use interim contracts, and assign existing staff to critical tasks pending hires.
gen_risks.evidence: PMU staff not yet contracted; procurement and admin specialist positions have been readvertised.

gen_risks.description: Coordination among >12 ministries and agencies is complex and may cause bottlenecks.
gen_risks.mitigation: Strengthen the Steering Committee, define a clear RACI matrix, and hold weekly coordination meetings.
gen_risks.evidence: Coordination among the different departments and agencies involved in the Project is complex.

gen_risks.description: Failure to verify DLIs on time could delay RBF disbursements and cash flow.
gen_risks.mitigation: Build a robust M&E system with third‑party validation and automate quarterly DLI reporting.
gen_risks.evidence: No disbursements under RBF will be made until DLI#5 is achieved.

gen_risks.description: Manual payroll systems increase risk of errors and fraud.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy the new HRMIS, automate payroll processing, and conduct regular reconciliations.
gen_risks.evidence: Payroll systems remain manual; extensive manual reconciliations required.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate public communication may lead to low service uptake.
gen_risks.mitigation: Launch a multi‑channel communication campaign (posters, SMS, radio) and monitor reach.
gen_risks.evidence: Information posters were hidden; telephone numbers went unattended.

gen_risks.description: Delays in annual external audits could affect compliance reporting.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prepare audit schedules early, provide auditors with complete documentation, and track audit deliverables.
gen_risks.evidence: Annual audit of EEPs due by Sep 30 2016; audit of PPF/TA due by Jun 30.

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
